Our model makes Pacific a 15.3-point favorite, projecting an 82-67 final, and gives Pacific a 90% chance to win. The betting market has Pacific favored by 11 with a total of 164.5. The model leans Pacific -11.0 and Under 164.5.
Players to watch: Jaion Pitt of Pacific, 16 points a game; Adriel Nyorha of Pacific, 13.6 points a game; Gavin Ripp of Pacific, 5.9 points a game.
Pacific played yesterday.

401935675.headline: West Coast Baptist vs. Pepperdine prediction: model has Pepperdine by 40
paragraphs: West Coast Baptist visits Pepperdine (2-3) at Firestone Fieldhouse in Malibu Friday at 8 PM ET.
Our model makes Pepperdine a 40.2-point favorite, projecting a 102-62 final. West Coast Baptist is not a Division I team, so books don't post a line and the model's number is rough.
Players to watch: Jahari Williamson of Pepperdine, 14.9 points a game; Alex Constanza of Pepperdine, 12.7 points a game; Anthony Robinson of Pepperdine, 10.5 points a game.
Pepperdine played yesterday.
flavor: The floor at Pepperdine's Firestone Fieldhouse measures 110 feet by 110 feet and has been replaced twice; the current floor is wooden.
